help.title: Help & FAQ
help.faq.gettingStarted.signIn.body: Sign in with your Google account from the login screen. Click the Google button and choose the account associated with CredChain.
help.faq.gettingStarted.googleAccount: Why do I need a Google account?
help.faq.gettingStarted.googleAccount.bo: CredChain uses Google as its identity provider. Your account is linked to your Google email so we can verify your identity without managing passwords.
help.faq.gettingStarted.unrecognizedEmai: What if my email isn't recognized?
Contact your administrator to be added to the platform. Only authorized email addresses can sign in.
help.faq.credentials.what.body: A digital record of an achievement or qualification. Each credential lives on the blockchain and is linked to your wallet. It can't be faked or transferred.
help.faq.credentials.verify: How do I verify a credential?
help.faq.credentials.verify.body: Go to the verification page, paste a credential ID or upload the file. We'll check it against the blockchain record.
help.faq.credentials.revoke: Can I revoke a credential I issued?
help.faq.credentials.revoke.body: Issuers and Admins can revoke credentials they've issued. Once revoked, the credential is permanently invalidated.
help.faq.account.roleDifference: What's the difference between Holder, Issuer, Admin?
help.faq.account.roleDifference.body: Holders can view and keep their own credentials. Issuers can do everything Holders can, plus issue, revoke, and verify credentials. Admins can do everything Issuers can, plus manage Holder and Issuer accounts.
help.faq.account.updateEmail: How do I update my email?
help.faq.account.updateEmail.body: From the user menu, click Update Email and sign in with the new Google account.
help.faq.account.logout.body: Sessions expire after a period of inactivity for security.
help.faq.privacy.tokenStorage.body: Authentication tokens are stored as httpOnly cookies that JavaScript cannot read.
help.faq.privacy.walletAddress: What does the wallet address mean?
help.faq.privacy.walletAddress.body: Your wallet address is your account on the blockchain. Credentials are linked to this address.
help.contact.title: Need more help?
help.contact.body: Send us an email. We'll get back to you within one business day.
about.title: About CredChain
about.what.title: What is CredChain?
about.what.body: CredChain lets organizations issue verifiable digital credentials. Each one is recorded on the blockchain, so anyone can check it's real — no middleman needed.
about.roles.title: Roles
about.roles.superAdmin.desc: Can do everything Admin can, plus manage Admin accounts and control the entire system. There is only one Super Admin, and the role can only be transferred to another user through a special process.
about.roles.admin.desc: Can do everything Issuer can, plus manage Holder and Issuer accounts, such as registering new users, changing their data and roles, or deactivating and restoring accounts. Admin cannot manage other Admins or the Super Admin.
about.roles.issuer.desc: Can do everything Holder can, plus issue, revoke, and verify digital credentials for other people.
about.roles.holder.desc: Receives digital credentials issued to them, then can view, download, and manage their own credentials and profile.
about.tech: Frontend: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS. Backend: Go. Smart contracts: Solidity.
about.contact.title: Contact the developer
about.contact.body: Questions, feedback, or partnership inquiries? Reach out directly.
about.contact.label: Developer email
about.explore.title: Ready to explore CredChain?
about.explore.body: See how verifiable credentials work, from issuing to verification.
